caption:
Most lost leads die for one reason: nobody claimed them.

They sit in a shared inbox. Everyone assumes someone else is on it. Three days later, it's cold.

Four rules fix this:

Name an owner the moment the lead arrives.
Surface unowned leads in a place everyone can see.
Define the exact moment ownership transfers between people.
Decide in advance what happens when a lead returns.

Pull up your lead list this week and count how many have no name on them. That's your leak.
